mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as capital costs rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns due to earnings contraction fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase and industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100) indicate economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns through earnings and risk premium effects.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND INDPRO falls < 100
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months and INDPRO falls < 100 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts exceeding 1500 thousand units signal housing market overvaluation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns via risk-off sentiment and valuation compression.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when HOUST > 1500 in late-cycle expansions over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 3% signals inflationary pressure, causing negative S&P 500 5-day returns through central bank rate hike expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 3% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 0.5% signals weak economic recovery, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day returns through reduced corporate earnings growth forecasts.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when GDPC1 quarterly growth rate < 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100) and manufacturing payrolls drop (PAYEMS decline > 0.5% in 3 months) indicate manufacturing sector weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls < 100 AND PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO falls < 100 and PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 3 months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) falling below 700,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day returns through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when RSAFS falls < 700,000 over a 3-year rolling window.
